name: MD Wordscloud
description: Shows a multi-dimensional word cloud using D3.js.
project_description:
Insprite from WordCloud , this module create a block, provide configurations for choose vocabulary and show it as MD wordcloud. Display of a term with many contents is bigger.

 Back to top 

 Requirements 
 1. D3 library: 
 
 Download D3 library 
 Extract and rename of the releases to 'd3', so the assets are at:
+ **/libraries/d3/d3.min.js**' 
 
 2. D3 Cloud library: 
 
 Download D3 Cloud 
 Extract and rename of the releases to 'd3-cloud', so the assets are at:
+ **/libraries/d3-cloud/build/d3.layout.cloud.js**' 
 
 Back to top 

 How to use: 
 
 After install module, Go to the "Block layout" page (under Structure) and use any of the "Place block" buttons to create a MD WordsCloud block. 
 Choose Vocabulary, number of words to display, words scale, how many orientation, words angle and save that block 
 If you have not reference term with node previously, Create some taxonomy term, create a reference field in content type and attach terms with node. 
 
 Similar projects 
 
 TagCloud 
 Dynamic Tag Clouds 
 
 How they are different? 
 
 In tagclouds options are available to enable only one vocabulary in a block, while in Md_wordscloud options are available to choose multiple vocabulary in one block. 
 The md_wordscloud visually represents the terms in multiple colors and provides options for word orientation as well as orientation angle from -90 to 90 degree, which other modules do not provide.
